svg.aria-label: Case file No. 8283: Rahul L S. Full-stack, cross-platform, AI systems. Reads the logs before he touches the code. He reads code like I read a room. The tell is never where it points. Web, mobile, desktop. Same pair of hands. The screen is incidental. He builds what sits behind it. LangGraph. Retrieval. A voice that picks up the phone. He never trusts a model alone. He gives it memory, and a way back.

g.text: There’s no such thing as magic. Only systems, read closely.
what he gives away without saying
Reads the logs before he touches the code.
He reads code like I read a room. The tell is never where it points.

The screen is incidental. He builds what sits behind it.
LangGraph. Retrieval. A voice that picks up the phone.
He never trusts a model alone. He gives it memory, and a way back.
you were going to scroll down anyway. — PJ
